cabs.name: Tempo Traveller
cabs.note: One vehicle for the whole group

services.name: One-Way Taxi
services.text: Pay for the drop only. A good fit when you are flying back, staying on, or simply do not need the car to wait.

services.name: Round Trip
services.text: Keep the same car and driver for the whole journey, with halts and sightseeing stops along the way.

services.name: Outstation Taxi
services.text: Long highway runs across Gujarat and into Maharashtra, for family visits, pilgrimages and weekend breaks.

services.name: Airport Transfer
services.text: Pickups and drops for Surat, Mumbai and Ahmedabad airports, timed to your flight so you are never rushing.

services.name: Wedding Car Rental
services.text: Cars for the couple and comfortable transport for guests, from the baraat to the last airport drop.

services.name: Corporate Travel
services.text: Client pickups, plant visits and day-long meeting schedules, with monthly billing for regular bookings.

services.name: Local City Ride
services.text: Hire a car by the hour for shopping, appointments and errands around Surat.
